The '''Induparan Crown Worlds Embassy''' was a converted guesthouse on [[Meihanna Island]], an island owned by the [[Geharran royal family]]. The embassy was established by the [[Induparan Crown Worlds]] in an attempt to influence [[Ebrahi]], the [[Prince/Legends|crown prince]] of [[Ord Gimmel/Legends|Ord Gimmel]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
